segments.contextAfter: *Effects* provide standard implementations of common shader effects. You configure the effect and the associated vertex data; the effect creates and loads an appropriate shader. GLKit includes three effects: The [`GLKBaseEffect`](glkbaseeffect.md) class implements a critical subset of the OpenGL ES 1.1 shading and lighting model, the [`GLKReflectionMapEffect`](glkreflectionmapeffect.md) class extends the base effect to include reflection mapping support, and the [`GLKSkyboxEffect`](glkskyboxeffect.md) class provides an implementation of a skybox effect.
